nodes.text: Stop. Boots. …Mm. They'll do to the Long Meadow. Past that, we should talk. Hask — outfitter, fletcher. Last shop before the High Road starts charging for its lessons.

choices.text: What does the road ask for?

nodes.text: Arrows — double what you brought. A snare kit, so dinner doesn't cost steel. Spare bowstring. Dry socks. And a healthy respect for nightfall. The road doesn't kill people. Going out *underprepared* kills people. I sell the difference.

Fifteen years. Escort sergeant, Amberford to the Last Lamp and back, more times than I've got teeth left. Retired the winter the worgs came down on the Fork rest and took two of mine _inside the fence line_. I keep their names off my tongue. Every buckle in this shop is that winter's lesson.

Best cadet I ever shouted at. Only one who ever shouted back with better information. When the Toll War broke, she's the one who went out on the ice and broke the Redmask chain with a mattock. The town gave her the gate the same week. I'd claim I taught her everything she knows — but she'd hear about it, and correct me publicly.
Racks are yours. Buy for the road you're walking, not the one you're bragging about.
